trigger.condition: Party enters fauxst_beach zone on any active filming day; no prerequisites

sequence.description: A crowd of college-age vacationers is already gathered. A crane-mounted EMTV camera swings out over the trucked-in sand.
sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: Boys. Boys. Look at the crane.

sequence.description: Petra delivers the full disclosure script, unprompted, in complete sentences, regardless of interruption.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_petra_production_assistant_01
sequence.dialogue: Hi. Yes. Sign-up is here. The show is called The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown. It is a trivia contest. The trivia is in Bohemian. All of it. Every question. There is no translator — we cut that from the budget in 2011. You will be strapped into a portable toilet. The portable toilet is attached to a pneumatic catapult. Three incorrect answers and the catapult fires you into the river. The river is The Bacchanus. It is not clean. It has never been clean. I want to be clear that I am not exaggerating for the show.

sequence.description: Three release forms, four pages each, single-spaced, entirely in Czech-parody legalese, fanned out.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_petra_production_assistant_01
sequence.dialogue: These are the release forms. They are in Bohemian. By signing, you waive the right to pursue us for injury, drowning, contamination, and 'reputational consequence in perpetuity across all media, known and not yet invented.' Would you like me to read them aloud in English? I am happy to. It takes eleven minutes.

sequence.description: Player picks ONE bro to answer for (Lord Pilsner / Chadwick / Bradley). The other two answer on autopilot and are launched at staggered intervals per minigame_beatdown_trivia_gauntlet.
Nine questions, three strikes. See mini_games.minigame_beatdown_trivia_gauntlet.
Jaxson doesn't announce it. He walks to the first lever while the crowd is still reacting to the previous answer and pulls it like he's closing a window. The first non-selected bro is launched.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: One down. Question five.

sequence.description: The second launch goes off mid-word. The bubble must terminate on a partial syllable; audio clips hard, then continues faintly over the water for ~1s at falling volume. Do not fade.
sequence.speaker: staging
sequence.dialogue: The sentence was never finished. It was, however, finished for him, by physics, which had been waiting patiently for its turn to speak.

post_event_effects.value: Chadwick/Path B only — can fire on any Phase 1 question via the 3rd GO LIVE activation (see mini_games.minigame_beatdown_trivia_gauntlet.path_b_go_live_mechanic), pre-empting the remainder of the gauntlet, janek_thrown_answer, and sudden_death entirely

sequence.description: Janek's crew team glides past in an eight, downriver. He watches them go instead of turning to answer.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: Janek. Question six.

sequence.description: It is not nine hundred. It is not a number question.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_janek_sykora_01
sequence.dialogue: Nine hundred.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_petra_production_assistant_01
sequence.dialogue: He does this.

sequence.speaker: selected_bro
sequence.dialogue: LOOK! LOOK AT HIM! Janek is CHOKING under the pressure, baby! HE'S CHOKING! I can SMELL it!

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_janek_sykora_01
sequence.dialogue: Is the loud sir talking to me?

post_event_effects.value: Janek Sýkora had not choked. Janek Sýkora had briefly stopped participating, which is a different thing, and which is available to anyone who does not need the prize.

trigger.condition: Selected bro finishes Q9 with <= 2 strikes

sequence.description: See mini_games.minigame_beatdown_sudden_death. Mid-question, Janek's crew team glides down The Bacchanus behind the set. He turns and waves at them for exactly 1.5 seconds; his buzzer hand leaves the buzzer.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_janek_sykora_01
sequence.dialogue: Ahoj! Ahoj, kluci!

post_event_effects.value: buzz inside 1.5s window and answer correctly
buzz early, buzz late, or 3rd gauntlet strike

trigger.condition: third strike (gauntlet) or non-selected-bro hard-timed launch (Q4/Q7) or sudden-death loss

sequence.description: Arc must visibly clear the inflatable palms and lifeguard tower before water contact.

events.note: Scope per status_effects.md's Port-O-Cologne source wording ('launched into the Bacchanus in a loaded port-o-potty'): ANY bro who goes through this event — selected-bro 3-strike loss, a non-selected bro's staggered Q4/Q7 launch, or a Sudden Death loss — gets port_o_cologne_active. The winning bro is never launched, so there is no overlap or conflict between this generic event and the WIN-branch prize podium.

trigger.condition: LOSS outcome only — 3rd gauntlet strike (any path) or a Sudden Death buzzer loss. NOT the DISQUALIFICATION branch; see disqualification_exit for Chadwick's 3rd GO LIVE activation.

sequence.description: The launched bros wade out of The Bacchanus. port_o_cologne is applied on contact with the shore. Fly particles begin.

They walk the length of the Bohemian Riviera, past bar after bar, dripping. Vacationers heckle in Czech-parody; see npcs.ambient_npcs.college_vacationers_group.heckle_mistranslation_pairs_walk_of_shame.
sequence.speaker: college_vacationers_group

sequence.description: A Shady Productions runner who does not make eye contact and does not stop moving extends item_hamagotchi_consolation. Petra is beside him, clipboard out, item never touching her hands.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_petra_production_assistant_01
sequence.dialogue: Please sign here to confirm receipt of one [1] second-place prize.
sequence.note: This handoff is narratively staged at the hostel door, off-site from the Bohemian Riviera location proper.

events.display_name: Disqualification (Path B / Chadwick GO LIVE Only)

trigger.condition: Chadwick's 3rd GO LIVE activation during minigame_beatdown_trivia_gauntlet (see mini_games.minigame_beatdown_trivia_gauntlet.path_b_go_live_mechanic.dq_on_third_use). Fires immediately, before the current question resolves — the gauntlet does not continue and Sudden Death is never reached.

sequence.description: Jaxson takes the Oakleys off completely, sets them on the podium, and walks to the lever — the one scripted moment his professional cool visibly costs him something.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: House rules. No devices in the toilet.

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.dialogue: It's not a device, it's a PRESS CREDENTIAL —

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: Unfortunately, bro.

sequence.description: No prize podium. No Hamstradamus ceremony. Hamstradamus is visibly holding a Hamagotchi at a distance and visibly puts it back in the box — no interaction, no hand-off, no dialogue.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_hamstradamus_01
sequence.note: This is a glimpsed background beat only, not a triggered dialogue phase for Hamstradamus.

events.note: Canon (bacchanusbeachbeatdown.md:225): status port_o_cologne ONLY. No item. No consolation prize. No Hamagotchi. Nothing. Do NOT grant item_hamagotchi_consolation on this branch — that item is reserved for the walk_of_shame (3-strikes LOSS) branch only. Chadwick's stream ends on the splash and the VOD auto-saves.

trigger.condition: WIN outcome — Sudden Death buzz succeeds

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: Ladies and gentlemen. In twenty-two seasons. For the first time. Unfortunately, bro — you actually won.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_hamstradamus_01
sequence.description: A small door opens in the base of the podium. Hamstradamus struts the full length of the card table, in profile, to a crowd reaction.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_hamstradamus_01
sequence.dialogue: HE WHO WEARS THE STAR OF SUMMER SHALL NEVER PAY FULL PRICE FOR ONION RINGS. REPENT.
sequence.note: Canon-locked verbatim. Spoken in English at full volume, not localized or subtitled through the Czech-parody pipeline.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_hamstradamus_01
sequence.dialogue: The star chooses. The star has chosen. Wear it, champion, and know: by the year Y2K plus twenty-six, a hamster in a speedo will have told you the truth, and you will not have listened.
sequence.note: Badge lands visibly crooked in the same animation that applies it.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_hamstradamus_01
sequence.dialogue: REPENT.
sequence.note: A separate, quieter delivery, not a repeat for pacing. Must not be cut.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_jaxson_vane_01
sequence.dialogue: And there it is. Twenty-two seasons of merch, gone.

sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_petra_production_assistant_01
sequence.dialogue: Confirm one badge, one stein, out of inventory. Log it as a loss.

events.display_name: The Outbreak (All-Night Party, Scripted Trio Event)

trigger.condition: Party enters night_party_zone during night-rave hours after beatdown_complete == true. Scripted and guaranteed — not avoidable, not skill-gated, not branchable. Origin point of debaucheryville_sidequest_nothing_is_getting_through_01.

sequence.description: Strobes, string lights, sound system. Beer goggles are rendered LITERALLY: three separate through-the-goggles moments, three oblivious bros, each unaware of the other two. Binding: the goggles' lie is her AGE — she renders as 22 — never her looks. She was never a downgrade, and no frame in this event is lit, framed, or scored as a horror reveal aimed at her.
Background dialogue from Riviera locals, spoken with genuine respect and mild awe. The bros do not connect the name to anyone in the room.
sequence.speaker: riviera_locals_background
sequence.dialogue: Renata's here somewhere tonight—

sequence.description: Hard cut to morning. Gulls that are almost certainly pigeons. Flat grey light. Chadwick and Bradley upright and destroyed; Lord Pilsner cocooned in a sleeping bag wearing only a leopard-print male thong that is not his.
sequence.note: Casting is author-locked: thong-bro is LORD PILSNER on every playthrough; Chadwick and Bradley are the standing bros. Not assigned at scene setup.

sequence.description: Chadwick holds up an item of clothing he has already decided not to think about. Implication only — no graphic content, morning-after wreckage exclusively.
sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.dialogue: Bro. Whose is this.

sequence.description: From inside the bag, without opening his eyes. This line IS the acquisition trigger for item_leopard_print_thong — the inventory-grant stinger fires on it, to Lord Pilsner, permanently.
sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: ...Mine now?

sequence.description: Renata rises from the other side of the sleeping bag STUNNING — impeccably put together, everything fastened, decades-deep bronze in the low morning light, enormous sunglasses on before she is fully upright. She redressed before she slept. She pats Chadwick and Bradley on the cheek, identically, exactly the way their mothers do (animation cheek_pat, twice, no variation), then throws both arms around Lord Pilsner's neck and kisses him on the mouth, then jogs off down the beach. She got exactly what she came for and is entirely at ease. She is not the joke; the frame is a straight comparison and it is not close.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_queen_riviera_renata_01
sequence.dialogue: You're such nice boys!

sequence.description: Mid-exit, the bros finally connect the name they heard all night. She answers with a wink, pride in her voice, and serious swagger.
sequence.speaker: debaucheryville_npc_queen_riviera_renata_01
sequence.dialogue: That's QUEEN Riviéra Renata to you!

sequence.description: The identical maternal affection delivered to all three IS the reveal. No cross-referencing dialogue. All three begin itching in unison.
sequence.speaker: staging
sequence.dialogue: Nobody said it out loud.

sequence.description: Bradley offers the evidence. Lord Pilsner has not gotten up; he runs the entire diagnosis from inside the bag. Surrounding banter (Pilsner's 'Diagnostic. Everybody itching?', Chadwick's replies, the 'It's ivy, Brad.' exchange) is owned by the quest file and is deliberately not restated here.
sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.dialogue: There was DEFINITELY foliage at that beach party.

sequence.description: Delivered from INSIDE the sleeping bag, flat on his back, still in the thong, with the authority of a diagnosis handed down from above — and enormous relief. Author-locked staging: he does not sit up for this line.
sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: POISON IVY. Thank God. Boys, that's poison ivy.

sequence.description: Delivered to the open air with the gravity of a man reporting a symptom to a medical professional, after Pilsner has stood up and elected not to address what he is wearing.
sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.dialogue: Bro it itches so bad it looks like we got CRABS.

post_event_effects.value: Lord Pilsner only, permanent — fires on the "...Mine now?" line during the thong_discovery_reply phase, not at event end. Cannot be sold, dropped, or traded. Its original owner is never established, here or anywhere.
Next beat is Věra's refusal at Midnight Munchies General Store, off-site from this location

interactive_objects.description: The center unit's door latch is visibly broken and swings open under its own weight. It's the unit whichever bro insists on because 'the center guy is the guy the show is about.'

easter_egg.reveal: Pilsner catches the swinging door with his foot without breaking eye contact with the camera and says it was 'a signature move.'

interactive_objects.description: Four pages, single-spaced, entirely in Czech-parody legalese. Waives the right to pursue Shady Productions for injury, drowning, contamination, and 'reputational consequence in perpetuity across all media, known and not yet invented.'

Hand-lettered, zip-tied to the lifeguard tower ladder: "NO DIVING (SERIOUSLY, IT'S 40cm)." The depth on the sign and the depth Standa the lifeguard will admit to under direct questioning do not match — nobody involved considers this a problem worth resolving.

easter_egg.reveal: The sign says forty. I'd call it closer to sixty, if you're asking me directly, which you are.

interactive_objects.description: A shrink-wrapped prize pallet stamped 2003, half-opened, visible in the background at catapult_row — badges, steins, and Hamagotchis in identical bulk, never pointed at by anyone on staff.

environmental_interactions.effect: Roped off with hazard tape and a four-language "DO NOT ENTER — FILMING EQUIPMENT" sign when idle (not an active filming day)

mini_games.display_name: The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown Trivia Gauntlet

mechanics.objective: Decode nine untranslated Czech-parody trivia questions and select the correct answer from four options before the selected bro's own confidently-wrong shout (which is always one of the four) or the 12-second timer.
mechanics.controls: Selected bro shouts his confidently-wrong answer first, unprompted, every round; player then picks from four multiple-choice options
mechanics.scoring: 3 strikes = launch (LOSS branch). <=2 strikes after Q9 = advance to minigame_beatdown_sudden_death

contestant_roles.selected_bro: Player-controlled answer window; only visible strike counter
contestant_roles.non_selected_bros: Fully scripted, zero player input, no on-screen strike counter; hard-timed strikeout at Q4 and Q7 (mid-sentence), never correct on any question
contestant_roles.janek: Answers all 9 correctly except one scripted thrown answer at ~Q6; cannot be struck out under any circumstance, no fail state, no exit before Sudden Death

mini_games.turn_structure: Round-robin within each question. Jaxson reads the question once; the three bros answer in podium order (left -> center -> right) as a scripted stack of confidently wrong shouts; Janek answers last, briefly, without looking up.
mini_games.language: Czech-parody, no subtitles, no translation toggle
mini_games.fail_state: 3 strikes -> launch -> LOSS branch (walk_of_shame). Separately, Chadwick's 3rd GO LIVE activation -> immediate DISQUALIFICATION (disqualification_exit), independent of strike count.

availability.visible_button: Only rendered/selectable when Chadwick is the selected bro; invisible for Lord Pilsner and Bradley paths

path_b_go_live_mechanic.when_usable: Available on any Phase 1 question. Disabled in Phase 2 (Sudden Death) — Jaxson personally unplugs the extension cord on camera, animated unplug, no commentary; button is not merely grayed out.
path_b_go_live_mechanic.effect: Opens the ICQ chat overlay for the window duration. Chat returns a crowd-sourced answer.

unreliable_result.description: Trolling. The trolling is confident (e.g. the chat unanimously answers 'BANANA' regardless of the actual question).

viewer_count_display.note: Reads 11 at all times, in all conditions. Never moves. The '(9 bots)' tag appears only in the closing frame of each ICQ overlay, small, unremarked.

path_b_go_live_mechanic.suspicion_trigger: Ticks on activation, not on outcome — a correct crowd-sourced answer costs exactly as much suspicion as 'BANANA.'

suspicion_meter_states.tick_1: Jaxson tilts the Oakleys down a quarter inch. Says nothing.
suspicion_meter_states.tick_2: Lowers them to the tip of his nose. Still says nothing. Drinks from all three cans.
suspicion_meter_states.tick_3: Takes them off completely, sets them on the podium, walks to the lever. Fires dq_on_third_use immediately.

dq_on_third_use.timing: Fires the launch immediately on the third activation, before the current question resolves. The player never learns whether the third answer was right.
dq_on_third_use.note: No item. No consolation prize. No Hamagotchi. No prize podium. Distinct from the 3-strikes LOSS branch, which still awards item_hamagotchi_consolation.

sample_icq_feed_q1: Tony420: say "banana" they LOVE that over there
xXsn1perXx69: bro why are you in a toilet

dialogue.chadwick_pre_answer: Chat, chat, chat — I need this. Nobody troll. I'm serious. This is my LIVELIHOOD.
dialogue.on_disqualification_jaxson: House rules. No devices in the toilet.
dialogue.chadwick_protest: It's not a device, it's a PRESS CREDENTIAL —

sample_questions.label: the softball
sample_questions.as_displayed_czech: Kolik hvězdiček má vlajka Evropské Unie?
sample_questions.visual_clue: Jaxson unfurls a small EU flag prop with one hand while holding all three energy drink cans in the other; absent-mindedly taps the flag twelve times against the podium

bro_wrong_shouts.lord_pilsner: FIFTY. Same as ours. That's how flags work, bro, that's the whole system.
bro_wrong_shouts.chadwick: Chat says twelve but chat also says banana, so — FIFTY.
bro_wrong_shouts.bradley: Fifty. Europe's got fifty states, they just don't advertise it.

sample_questions.on_correct: The crowd applauds. Pilsner assumes the applause is for him having been overruled gracefully.
sample_questions.on_incorrect: Strike one, and folks, that was the free one.

sample_questions.label: the metric trap
sample_questions.visual_clue: Jaxson raises an empty half-liter glass to the crane camera; the crowd, unprompted, begins a slow rhythmic chant of "pět… pět… pět…"

bro_wrong_shouts.lord_pilsner: A liter and a HALF. I know because I've had nine of 'em and I can still spell my name.
bro_wrong_shouts.chadwick: Whatever's bigger. Go bigger. Big numbers do numbers.
bro_wrong_shouts.bradley: It's a gallon. Metric gallon. Slightly smaller than a regular gallon, which is why you gotta drink more of 'em.

sample_questions.on_correct: The chant becomes a cheer. Bro: "See, I let the crowd think they helped. That's leadership."
sample_questions.on_incorrect: The chanting stops. The silence is worse. Somewhere in the crowd, one person says 'he was told.'

sample_questions.label: the one that is a warning
sample_questions.as_displayed_czech: Jak se jmenuje řeka, do které za chvíli spadneš?
sample_questions.visual_clue: Jaxson gestures, in order, at the river, the port-o-potty the bro is strapped inside, and the river again, holding the last gesture; crowd is already laughing before the question finishes

bro_wrong_shouts.lord_pilsner: The PUBLANDIA. Bro, all of them are the Publandia at some point, it's a whole system, it's like a subway.
bro_wrong_shouts.chadwick: THE SINFONIA. Every river in Europe is the Sinfonia, they just rename it per country for tourism reasons.
bro_wrong_shouts.bradley: There's no river. There's no river in this question. He's testing whether we'll invent a river.

sample_questions.on_correct: Jaxson lowers the Oakleys a quarter inch — the only unscripted thing he does all episode. "...Huh."
sample_questions.on_incorrect: "The show had, at this point, told him the name of the river he was about to enter, shown him the toilet he would enter it in, and pointed at both. He answered 'the Sinfonia.' The production had done everything it could."

rewards.failure_loss_3_strikes: Launch -> walk_of_shame event -> item_hamagotchi_consolation + port_o_cologne status
rewards.failure_disqualification_go_live: Immediate launch mid-question, Chadwick/Path B only, 3rd GO LIVE activation -> disqualification_exit event -> port_o_cologne status ONLY, no item, no podium

mechanics.objective: Buzz inside the 1.5-second window when Janek's attention leaves the buzzer for his crew team, then answer correctly from four options.
mechanics.controls: Single buzzer input, timed against an audio-only tell
mechanics.scoring: Win condition: buzz inside the 1.5s window and answer correctly. Buzz early or buzz late = instant loss.

mini_games.trigger: Selected bro finishes Q9 with <=2 strikes
mini_games.format: Head-to-head buzzer duel vs. debaucheryville_npc_janek_sykora_01. One question. First buzz answers.
mini_games.the_catch: Janek is faster than the player on reflex, always, without exception. He cannot be out-buzzed on merit.
mini_games.window_description: Mid-question, Janek's crew team glides down The Bacchanus behind the set. He turns and waves at them for exactly 1.5 seconds; his buzzer hand leaves the buzzer.
mini_games.buzz_late_result: Janek's hand is back. Instant loss.
mini_games.tell: Audio cue only — rhythmic catch-and-release of eight oars, faintly, under the crowd noise, ramping for two full seconds before he turns. Mixed above crowd noise; the only skill-gate tell in the entire quest.

on_winning_buzz.janek: Good! Good for the sir. He got one.
on_winning_buzz.winning_bro: HE'S CONGRATULATING ME. THE KID IS CONGRATULATING ME.

rewards.success: prize_ceremony event -> item_trivia_champ_badge + item_summer_vacay_stein + 3 Bravado + achievement Beach's Finest

visit_2_plus.note: Petra discloses the same complete script to every new sign-up group; Jaxson hosts every taping as 'season one'; Janek greets returning parties warmly but does not remember them distinctly.

episode_airing.trigger: approximately 1 in-game day after beatdown_complete becomes true
episode_airing.effect: The aired Beatdown episode begins looping on bar_strip bar TVs — a short (~20s) CRT-filtered edit with the 'HOSTE' lower-third graphic, reused across all three bars (Za Za Beach Klub, The Tan Line, Kokos Loco) as a single shared low-res asset, not rendered per-venue.
episode_airing.on_win: The bros' faces are on screens in every bar they walk into; they interpret this as fame.
episode_airing.on_loss: The launch is the clip that gets replayed, and it gets replayed a lot, because it is the good part.

riverbank_monuments.effect: The launched units, fished out by Rosta, become permanent, navigable riverbank landmarks. By Day 6+, one has a vendor set up next to it and someone's laundry on it.

staging_notes.on_entering: A landlocked country's beach resort, built entirely out of confidence and trucked-in sand.
staging_notes.on_key_moment: The sentence was never finished. It was, however, finished for him, by physics, which had been waiting patiently for its turn to speak.
staging_notes.on_signing_forms: Three men signed away their likeness, their dignity, and their right to legal recourse in perpetuity across all media known and not yet invented. Two of them did it while flexing. The third did it on behalf of the other two, which is not how that works, and which Petra noted for the record, twice, out loud.
staging_notes.on_second_port_o_potty_impact: There is a specific sound a portable toilet makes when it strikes a river at forty kilometers an hour, and the network had, over twenty-two seasons, come to think of it as their theme music.
staging_notes.on_walk_of_shame: They walked the length of the Bohemian Riviera in a language they could not speak, being told exactly what had happened to them, in detail, by children — and arrived at their hostel believing they had been applauded.
staging_notes.on_prize_podium_win: A hamster in a wizard hat and a beach-appropriate speedo pinned a plastic star to a man's chest, and told him the truth about his future in capital letters, and he did not hear a word of it, because the star was shiny and the crowd was loud and he was, at long last, being looked at.
staging_notes.on_janek_thrown_answer: Janek Sýkora had not choked. Janek Sýkora had briefly stopped participating, which is a different thing, and which is available to anyone who does not need the prize.
staging_notes.on_disqualification: House rules. No devices in the toilet. Chadwick's stream ends on the splash and the VOD auto-saves.
staging_notes.on_exit: The catapult stays. It is never dismantled. Between filming days it is simply there, on a beach, roped off with hazard tape.
